definition_zh: 建模；模型制作；用数学或计算机方法对现实对象作简化模拟；模特职业
definition_en: the activity of making a model, especially a simplified mathematical or computer representation of a real system
core_image: 一张纸上先画出桥的骨架，再把每根杆编号成可以计算的线段
scene: 工程师在屏幕上把一座桥的受力情况搭成可计算的骨架，反复改参数看结果。 Careful modeling showed where the bridge would sag.
sceneCN: 这里指用数学或计算机方式对现实对象作模拟（第 2 个义项：数学建模）；句意为细致的建模显示出桥会在哪里下弯。图中可辨识物件：屏幕、曲线、桥的骨架、参数表。

pos.zh: 建模；模型制作；模拟；模特工作

derivatives.zh: 模型；模特；模范；制作模型

senses.title: Making a physical model
senses.definition: the activity of building a small object that represents a larger thing
senses.definitionCN: 制作一个小物件以代表更大实物的活动
senses.example: The modeling of the wing took three weeks in the workshop.
senses.exampleCN: 机翼模型的制作在车间花了三周。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a hand making a reduced copy, and every later sense keeps that idea of a stand-in.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是用手做出缩小的复制件，后来每一层意思都保留了这个替身的念头。

senses.title: Mathematical modeling
senses.definition: the activity of describing a real system with equations so that its behaviour can be calculated
senses.definitionCN: 用方程描述真实系统、使其行为可以被计算的活动
senses.example: Mathematical modeling predicted the flood level within ten centimetres.
senses.exampleCN: 数学建模把洪水水位的预测误差控制在十厘米内。
senses.why: The copy stops being an object and becomes a set of relations, but it still stands in for the real thing.
senses.whyCN: 复制件不再是一件实物，而变成一组关系，但它仍然替真实之物站台。

senses.title: Computer simulation
senses.definition: the building of a computational representation of a system and the running of it under changing conditions
senses.definitionCN: 为系统建立计算表示，并在变化条件下运行它
senses.example: Climate modeling needs enormous computing power.
senses.exampleCN: 气候模拟需要极大的算力。
senses.why: Once the equations could be run on a machine, modeling became an experiment performed inside a computer.
senses.whyCN: 当方程可以在机器上运行，建模就变成了在计算机内部做的实验。

senses.title: Three-dimensional modeling
senses.definition: the construction of a digital three-dimensional shape that can be rotated, lit and rendered
senses.definitionCN: 构建可旋转、打光并渲染的数字三维形体
senses.example: The studio teaches 3D modeling for game assets.
senses.exampleCN: 工作室教授用于游戏资产的三维建模。
senses.why: A screen gives the old clay copy a new material: surface without weight.
senses.whyCN: 屏幕给了旧日的黏土复制件一种新材质：没有重量的表面。

senses.title: Financial modeling
senses.definition: the building of a spreadsheet or calculation that projects a company's income, costs and value
senses.definitionCN: 用表格或计算来推演企业收入、成本与价值的活动
senses.example: Her financial modeling convinced the board to delay the purchase.
senses.exampleCN: 她的财务建模说服董事会推迟采购。
senses.why: The same habit of building a stand-in is applied to money, where the model predicts rather than depicts.
senses.whyCN: 同一套造替身的习惯被用到钱上，此时模型是预测而非描摹。

senses.title: Fashion modeling
senses.definition: the profession of posing for photographs or walking in shows to display clothes
senses.definitionCN: 为拍照摆姿势或走秀展示服装的职业
senses.example: Fashion modeling took him to four cities in one month.
senses.exampleCN: 模特工作让他一个月跑了四座城市。
senses.why: Here the living body itself is the copy, standing in for the garment's ideal wearer.
senses.whyCN: 这里活人的身体本身就是复制件，替服装理想的穿着者站台。

senses.title: Behaviour modeling
senses.definition: the learning of behaviour by watching and copying another person
senses.definitionCN: 通过观察与模仿他人来学习行为
senses.example: Behaviour modeling helps new staff learn the safety routine.
senses.exampleCN: 行为示范帮助新员工学会安全流程。
senses.why: The pattern to be copied is no longer an object but a way of acting, which is the furthest reach of the word.
senses.whyCN: 被复制的对象不再是物件，而是一种行事方式，这是这个词走得最远的一步。

senses.title: Clay and sculpture modeling
senses.definition: the shaping of soft material by hand into a three-dimensional form
senses.definitionCN: 用手把柔软材料塑成立体形状
senses.example: Clay modeling is the first class in the sculpture course.
senses.exampleCN: 黏土塑造是雕塑课的第一堂课。
senses.why: This is the workshop sense at its plainest: fingers pressing a material until it holds the intended shape.
senses.whyCN: 这是最朴素的工坊义：手指按压材料，直到它呈现想要的形状。

intro.en: Modeling is model plus -ing. Model came into English from French modelle, from Italian modello, from a reconstructed Vulgar Latin diminutive of modulus 'small measure'. The British spelling doubles the l.
intro.cn: modeling 是 model 加 -ing。model 经法语 modelle、意大利语 modello，上溯到俗拉丁语中 modulus「小量度」的一个重构指小形式；英式拼写双写 l。

items.en: Latin modus meant a measure, a manner or a limit, the base of modulus and of the English words mode and moderate.
items.cn: 拉丁 modus 指量度、方式或限度，是 modulus 以及英语 mode、moderate 的基础。

items.en: Modulus was a small measure or a standard unit, used for a model, a mould or a rhythmic unit.
items.cn: modulus 指小量度或标准单位，用于模型、模具或节律单位。

items.en: A Vulgar Latin diminutive of modulus is reconstructed as the source of the Italian and French forms; the exact shape is a reconstructed form, not an attested word.
items.cn: 俗拉丁语中 modulus 的一个指小形式被重构为意大利语与法语词形的来源；其确切形态是重构形式，并非有记录的词。

items.en: Italian modello and French modelle both meant a small copy or a pattern, and French carried the word into English in the sixteenth century.
items.cn: 意大利语 modello 与法语 modelle 都指小复制件或样板，法语在十六世纪把这个词带进英语。

items.en: English model first named an architect's pattern or a small copy, then widened to a person worth imitating and to a version of a product.
items.cn: 英语 model 最初指建筑师的样板或小复制件，后来扩展到值得模仿的人以及产品的型号。

items.en: The ending -ing turns the verb into the name of the activity, so modeling is the work of making or using a model; British spelling keeps the doubled l before the ending.
items.cn: 词尾 -ing 把动词变成活动名称，因此 modeling 指制作或使用模型的工作；英式拼写在词尾前保留双写的 l。

note.en: The first group looks or sounds like modeling; the second group names neighbouring ideas in the same field.
note.cn: 第一组在形音上与「modeling」相近；第二组是同一领域里意思相邻的其他说法。

entries.definition: The base noun and verb behind the activity; it names the thing or the act, not the ongoing work.
entries.definitionCN: 这项活动背后的名词与动词，指事物或动作，而不是持续的工作。

entries.definition: The same word written with a doubled l, standard in British English.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个词的英式拼写，双写 l。

entries.definition: A person who builds models, spelled with a doubled l in British usage.
entries.definitionCN: 建造模型的人，英式拼写双写 l。

entries.definition: Relating to mode or manner, especially in grammar or music; it shares modus but not the copy.
entries.definitionCN: 与方式或调式有关，尤用于语法或音乐；它共享 modus，但没有复制件之义。

entries.definition: A measured unit or separable part, from the same small-measure root.
entries.definitionCN: 量度单位或可拆分部件，同出那个「小量度」词根。

entries.definition: The running of an imitation of a system, often to see how it behaves.
entries.definitionCN: 运行系统的仿制品，常用来看它会如何表现。

entries.definition: Any stand-in for something else, whether a picture, a symbol or a set of equations.
entries.definitionCN: 任何替代他物的东西，无论是图像、符号还是一组方程。

entries.definition: Imitation that aims to match the original's behaviour closely, often in computing.
entries.definitionCN: 力求贴近原物行为的模仿，常用于计算领域。

entries.definition: Building a first working version to test an idea.
entries.definitionCN: 造出第一个可工作的版本以检验构想。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin measure word, the real spelling variants and real technical phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁「量度」词、真实拼写变体与真实技术搭配。

normal.en: The root modus is Latin for measure, so a model is something measured out as a stand-in.
normal.cn: 词根 modus 是拉丁语「量度」，因此模型就是量出来充当替身的东西。

normal.en: The family runs model, modeling, modeler, modeled and remodel.
normal.cn: 同族词有 model、modeling、modeler、modeled 与 remodel。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the fields: mathematical modeling, climate modeling, 3D modeling, financial modeling.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出领域：数学建模、气候建模、三维建模、财务建模。

normal.en: British English writes modelling with a doubled l, American English writes modeling.
normal.cn: 英式英语写作 modelling，双写 l；美式英语写作 modeling。

normal.en: The suffix -ing names the activity rather than the object.
normal.cn: 后缀 -ing 命名的是活动，而不是物件。

abstract.en: The model is a stand-in small enough to turn in the hand.
abstract.cn: 模型是一个小到能在手里转动的替身。

abstract.en: The equations are the same stand-in, only now made of relations instead of wood.
abstract.cn: 方程是同一个替身，只是材质从木头换成了关系。

abstract.en: A model that predicts is a copy that looks forward.
abstract.cn: 会预测的模型，是一个朝前看的复制件。

examples.cn: 数学建模把设计周期缩短了一半。

examples.en: The team used modeling to test the layout before building it.

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one stand-in: a reduced object, a set of equations, a computer experiment, a digital surface, a financial projection, a posing body, a copied behaviour, and clay under the fingers.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bridge drawn as numbered rods on paper, small enough to calculate and real enough to predict.
core.cn: 核心意象：一座桥被画成纸上编号的杆件，小到可以计算，又真实到可以预测。

branches.en: THE PHYSICAL COPY: a hand builds a reduced object so that the real one can be discussed.
branches.cn: 实物复制件：手做出缩小件，好让人能讨论真正的那个。

branches.en: THE EQUATIONS: the copy becomes a set of relations that can be solved.
branches.cn: 方程：复制件变成一组可求解的关系。

branches.en: THE MACHINE COPY: equations are run, and shapes are built and lit inside a screen.
branches.cn: 机器复制件：方程被运行，形体在屏幕里被搭起并打光。

branches.en: THE MONEY COPY: the same stand-in is pointed at income, cost and value.
branches.cn: 钱的复制件：同一个替身被指向收入、成本与价值。

branches.en: THE HUMAN COPY: a body poses for a garment, a person copies a behaviour, fingers press clay into shape.
branches.cn: 人的复制件：身体替服装摆姿势，人模仿一种行为，手指把黏土压成形。

definition_zh: v. 逐渐变小；缩小；减少；衰退
definition_en: to become gradually smaller, fewer or weaker, often until only a little is left
core_image: 储物架从十二袋粮食变成两袋，中间空出一格格；水池石阶上留着一圈圈旧水位痕，最上面那圈干得发白；蜡烛火苗缩成一粒蓝珠；满场听众散到只剩路灯下三个人
scene: 水池边石阶上留着一圈圈旧水位痕，最上面那一圈已经干得发白，露出浅浅的盐渍。 The water level continued to dwindle through the dry summer.
sceneCN: 这里 dwindle 指「数量或体积一点点变少」（第 1 个义项：逐渐减少）；句意是整个干旱的夏天水位持续下降。图中可辨识物件：石阶、一圈圈旧水位痕、发白的盐渍。

pos.zh: 逐渐变小；缩小；减少；衰退

senses.title: To become fewer or less
senses.definition: to become gradually fewer or less in amount
senses.definitionCN: （动词）数量或份量一点点变少
senses.example: Supplies began to dwindle after the third week of the siege.
senses.exampleCN: 围城进入第三周后，补给开始逐渐减少。
senses.why: A store shelf that held twelve sacks now holds two, with empty gaps between them.
senses.whyCN: 原本放着十二袋粮食的储物架如今只剩两袋，中间空出一格格。

senses.title: To become weaker or fainter
senses.definition: to become gradually weaker, fainter or less strong
senses.definitionCN: （动词）力量、声音或光亮一点点变弱
senses.example: Her voice dwindled to a whisper as the lights went out.
senses.exampleCN: 灯灭之后，她的声音渐渐弱成耳语。
senses.why: A candle flame shrinks to a blue bead while the pool of wax spreads wider.
senses.whyCN: 蜡烛火苗缩成一粒蓝珠，蜡油却摊得更宽。

senses.title: To shrink to a small remainder
senses.definition: to shrink until only a small part is left
senses.definitionCN: （动词）一直缩到只剩下一小部分
senses.example: The crowd dwindled to a handful of people waiting in the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 人群渐渐散去，只剩寥寥几个人在雨里等着。
senses.why: A full square of listeners empties until three figures stand under one lamp.
senses.whyCN: 挤满听众的广场空了下来，最后只剩三个人站在一盏路灯下。

intro.en: Dwindle is dwine plus -le, an ending that turns a verb into a repeated small action; dwine goes back to Old English dwinan, to waste away, so the word carries the picture of losing a little again and again.
intro.cn: dwindle 由 dwine 加 -le 构成，这个后缀把动词变成反复发生的小幅动作；dwine 源自古英语 dwinan「消瘦」，所以这个词自带「一次次少掉一点」的画面。

items.en: Old English dwinan meant to waste away or to pine.
items.cn: 古英语 dwinan 意为消瘦、憔悴。

items.en: Middle English dwinen kept the sense of fading little by little.
items.cn: 中古英语 dwinen 保留「一点点消退」这一义。

items.en: The ending -le was added to make a verb of repeated small shrinking.
items.cn: 加上后缀 -le，构成表示反复小幅缩减的动词。

items.en: Early modern writers used dwindle for fortunes and bodies wasting away.
items.cn: 近代早期作家用 dwindle 指家产与身体的耗损。

items.en: Dwindle spread to hopes, crowds and supplies as well as physical size.
items.cn: dwindle 扩展到希望、人群与补给，不只指体积。

items.en: Today dwindle is the common word for a slow steady falling away.
items.cn: 今天 dwindle 是表示缓慢持续减少的常用词。

note.en: Dwindle and swindle differ by one letter but share nothing in meaning; the -le ending marks a repeated small action, as in sparkle and crackle.
note.cn: dwindle 与 swindle 只差一个字母，意思却毫不相干；后缀 -le 表示反复的小幅动作，sparkle、crackle 也是这一类。

dict_mnemonic.text: dwindle ＝ dwine（消瘦，古英语 dwinan）＋ -le（反复的小幅动作）＝「一次次少掉一点」。-le 这一族还有 sparkle（一闪一闪）、crackle（噼啪作响）、wriggle（扭来扭去），都是「小动作重复发生」。注意 dwindle 是不及物动词：主语自己变小，说 supplies dwindle，不能说 dwindle the supplies。常接 to 表示终点：dwindle to nothing／to a handful。形近词 swindle 是「诈骗」，只差一个字母，别认混。近义词 diminish 可及物可不及物，shrink 偏体积收缩，wane 偏月亮与势力的衰退。

root: 古英语 dwinan（消瘦）→ 中古英语 dwinen → dwine ＋ -le（反复小幅动作）→ dwindle（逐渐变小）

sensesIntro.en: Losing a little at a time: a shelf with empty gaps where sacks stood, a flame shrunk to a blue bead and a square left with three figures under one lamp.
sensesIntro.cn: 一点点少下去：原本堆着粮袋的架子空出一格格、火苗缩成一粒蓝珠，以及只剩路灯下三个人的广场。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a store shelf that held twelve sacks now holds two with empty gaps between them
core.cn: 核心意象：原本放着十二袋粮食的储物架如今只剩两袋，中间空出一格格

branches.en: Amount and number fall slowly.
branches.cn: 份量与数量缓慢下降。

branches.en: Strength, sound and light grow faint.
branches.cn: 力量、声音与光亮变弱。

branches.en: Only a small remainder is left.
branches.cn: 只剩下一小部分。

branches.en: The falling ends in a handful.
branches.cn: 减少的终点是寥寥几个。

branches.en: Fading until almost nothing remains.
branches.cn: 一直淡到几乎不剩。

intro.en: Dwindle is dwine plus the frequentative -le; dis- and min- build diminish, while wan- gives wane and German schwind- gives the look-alike swindle.
intro.cn: dwindle 由 dwine 加表反复的后缀 -le 组成；dis- 与 min- 造出 diminish，wan- 给出 wane，德语 schwind- 则给出形近词 swindle。

latinIntro.en: Latin minuere means to make less, minor smaller and minutus very small; these give diminish and minute.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 minuere 意为使变少，minor 意为更小，minutus 意为极小；它们给出 diminish 与 minute。

definition_zh: 污染；污染状态；有害物质或能量进入环境并造成损害
definition_en: the introduction of harmful substances or energy into the environment, or the state of being damaged by them
core_image: 河湾水面浮着一层彩色油光，岸边芦苇被塑料绳缠住，清水已成危险之物
scene: 河湾的水面漂着一层彩色油光，岸边芦苇被塑料绳缠住。 Pollution had turned the once clear river into a hazard.
sceneCN: 这里 pollution 指「水体受到有害物质侵入而变坏的状态」（第 4 个义项：水污染使水体失去原有用途）；句意为污染把曾经清澈的河变成了危险之地。图中可辨识物件：河湾、油光水膜、塑料绳、芦苇；对应第 1 个义项。

pos.zh: 污染；污染状态（不可数为主，复数指多种或多次污染）

senses.title: Harmful matter or energy entering the environment
senses.titleCN: 有害物质或能量进入环境
senses.definition: the act of putting harmful substances or excess energy into air, water or soil
senses.definitionCN: 把有害物质或过量能量放入空气、水体或土壤的行为
senses.example: Pollution had turned the once clear river into a hazard.
senses.exampleCN: 污染把曾经清澈的河变成了危险之地。
senses.why: The word names the act before it names the result: something is put into a medium that was not there before.
senses.whyCN: 这个词先命名动作，再命名结果：某物被放进了本来没有它的介质里。

senses.title: The damaged state of a medium
senses.definition: the condition of air, water or land after harmful matter has entered it
senses.definitionCN: 空气、水或土地在有害物质进入之后所处的状态
senses.example: The lake's pollution was visible as a green scum.
senses.exampleCN: 湖水的污染表现为一层绿色浮沫。
senses.why: English uses the same noun for the act and its result, so pollution can be what was done and what is now there.
senses.whyCN: 英语用同一个名词兼指动作与结果，因此 pollution 既可以是「做了什么」，也可以是「现在有什么」。

senses.title: Air pollution
senses.definition: the presence of smoke, gases or particles in the air at harmful concentrations
senses.definitionCN: 烟、气体或颗粒以有害浓度存在于空气中
senses.example: Winter air pollution settles over the plain and hides the hills.
senses.exampleCN: 冬季的空气污染压在平原上，把群山遮住。
senses.why: Coal smoke made this sense the first and most visible kind of pollution in industrial cities.
senses.whyCN: 煤烟使这个义项成为工业城市里最早、最可见的一种污染。

senses.title: Water pollution
senses.definition: the entry of sewage, chemicals or waste into rivers, lakes, groundwater or the sea
senses.definitionCN: 污水、化学品或废物进入河流、湖泊、地下水或海洋
senses.example: Water pollution from the tannery reached the wells downstream.
senses.exampleCN: 制革厂造成的水污染波及下游的水井。
senses.why: Water carries harm away from the source, so the word stresses the medium that spreads it.
senses.whyCN: 水把危害从源头带走，这个词于是强调传播它的介质。

senses.title: Soil and land pollution
senses.definition: the accumulation of harmful substances in soil, or the degradation of land by waste
senses.definitionCN: 有害物质在土壤中累积，或土地因废物而退化
senses.example: Soil pollution kept the allotments out of use for years.
senses.exampleCN: 土壤污染让这些菜地多年不能使用。
senses.why: Soil holds what air and water deliver, so pollution here is a deposit that stays in place.
senses.whyCN: 土壤承接空气与水送来的东西，这里的污染是留在原地的沉积。

senses.title: Noise, light and heat pollution
senses.definition: excess energy that harms health, wildlife or the quality of a place without adding substance
senses.definitionCN: 过量的能量，不添加物质却危害健康、野生生物或环境品质
senses.example: Light pollution erased the stars above the coastal towns.
senses.exampleCN: 光污染抹去了沿海城镇上空的星空。
senses.why: Modern regulation widened the word to energy, because harm does not require a material to be present.
senses.whyCN: 现代监管把这个词扩展到能量，因为造成危害并不需要有物质在场。

senses.title: Plastic and marine pollution
senses.definition: the accumulation of persistent waste, especially plastics, in oceans and on shores
senses.definitionCN: 持久性废物、尤其是塑料，在海洋与海岸上的累积
senses.example: Marine pollution washed ashore as bottle caps and netting.
senses.exampleCN: 海洋污染以瓶盖和网绳的形式冲上岸。
senses.why: A single material became so dominant that it earned its own use of the word.
senses.whyCN: 单一材料变得如此突出，以至于单独占用了这个词的一种用法。

senses.title: Ritual or moral defilement
senses.definition: the historical sense of making something sacred or pure unclean
senses.definitionCN: 使神圣或纯洁之物变得不洁的旧义
senses.example: The old texts speak of pollution that required a rite of cleansing.
senses.exampleCN: 古籍中说到需要行洁净礼才能解除的玷污。
senses.why: The word entered English as a religious term, and the environmental sense is a later branch of the same image.
senses.whyCN: 这个词以宗教术语进入英语，环境义是同一意象后来分出的枝。

senses.title: Abstract: degradation of information or discourse
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：信息与言论环境的变质
senses.definition: a transferred use for the flooding of a field with false, low-quality or manipulative content
senses.definitionCN: 转指某领域被虚假、低质或操纵性内容淹没
senses.example: Information pollution makes a reliable source harder to find.
senses.exampleCN: 信息污染使可靠来源更难找到。
senses.why: The metaphor preserves the structure: a shared medium is filled with something that lowers its value for everyone.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻保留了结构：共用的介质被填入某物，使它对所有人都贬值。

intro.en: Pollution came to English through French from Latin pollutio, a noun of defilement. Its oldest English sense is religious; the environmental sense is modern. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: pollution 经法语来自拉丁 pollutio，是一个表示「玷污」的名词。它最早的英语义项是宗教性的，环境义则是近代的。年代均为约数。

items.en: The verb behind the noun is usually divided into por- (a form of pro- 'forth') and luere 'to wash'. The deeper origin of luere is uncertain, and the relation sometimes drawn to lavare 'to wash' is a related-form hypothesis, not a proved descent.
items.cn: 这个名词背后的动词通常拆成 por-（pro-「向前」的一种形式）与 luere「洗」。luere 的更深来源不确定，有人把它与 lavare「洗」联系，那只是「相关形式」的假说，并非已证实的承继。

items.en: Polluere meant 'to defile, to corrupt'. How the washing element came to mean defiling is not fully explained; one account treats the prefix as intensive rather than directional.
items.cn: polluere 意为「弄脏、败坏」。「洗」的成分如何转为「弄脏」，并未得到完整解释；一种说法把前缀视为加强成分而非方向成分。

items.en: Late Latin pollutio named a defiling, especially ritual uncleanness, and this is the sense that entered English.
items.cn: 晚期拉丁 pollutio 指玷污，尤指仪式上的不洁，进入英语的正是这一义项。

items.en: From the fourteenth century English pollution meant the desecration of sacred things or the state of being ritually unclean.
items.cn: 从十四世纪起，英语 pollution 指对神圣之物的亵渎或仪式上的不洁状态。

items.en: In the nineteenth century smoke, sewage and factory waste gave the word its modern environmental sense, and it soon became a public-health issue.
items.cn: 十九世纪，烟、污水与工厂废料赋予这个词现代环境义，它很快成为公共卫生议题。

items.en: Source uncertain (internal history of polluere, first date of the environmental sense): the semantic path from washing to defiling is unexplained and the first environmental citation is not fixed, so its date is approximate; any older form offered for luere is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（polluere 的内部构造、环境义的首见年代）：从「洗」到「弄脏」的语义路径未获解释，环境义的最早书证也无定论，年代只能约计；凡为 luere 给出的更早形式均属重构。

note.en: Group one holds forms of the same pollute stock that differ in grammar or role; group two holds other words for environmental damage, each naming a different part of the problem.
note.cn: 第一组是同出 pollute 词干、语法角色不同的形式；第二组是其他表示环境损害的词，各自命名问题的一个不同部分。

entries.definition: A single offending substance; pollution is the resulting condition or the whole accumulation.
entries.definitionCN: 一种肇事的物质；pollution 是造成的结果或整体累积。

entries.definition: To put harmful matter into a medium; the noun names what the verb produces.
entries.definitionCN: 把有害物质放入介质；名词指动词所产生的状态。

entries.definition: A person or firm that pollutes; it is a responsible party, not a condition.
entries.definitionCN: 造成污染的人或企业；它是责任方，而非状态。

entries.definition: A head, a vote survey or a hornless beast, from Middle English polle; the resemblance to pollute is accidental.
entries.definitionCN: 指头、投票调查或无角牲畜，出自中古英语 polle；与 pollute 的相似只是偶然。

entries.definition: The making impure of a substance or product; it need not harm an ecosystem, which pollution implies.
entries.definitionCN: 使物质或产品不纯；它未必危害生态，而 pollution 含有这一层。

entries.definition: A general lowering of quality or condition; pollution is one cause of environmental degradation.
entries.definitionCN: 品质或状况的普遍下降；污染是环境退化的一个原因。

entries.definition: The release of a substance into the air; pollution is the harm that follows from such releases.
entries.definitionCN: 物质向空气的排放；pollution 是这类排放带来的危害。

entries.definition: The clogging or dirtying of equipment, hulls or beds; it is a practical nuisance sense, not a public-health one.
entries.definitionCN: 设备、船体或床层的堵塞与污损；它是设备层面的麻烦义，而非公共卫生义。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Pollution is the noun of pollute: the act of putting harm into a medium and the state that follows.
normal.cn: pollution 是 pollute 的名词：把危害放入介质的动作，以及随之而来的状态。

normal.en: The family runs pollute, pollutant, polluter, polluted and polluting.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 pollute、pollutant、polluter、polluted 与 polluting。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the medium: air pollution, water pollution, soil pollution, noise pollution.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出介质：空气污染、水污染、土壤污染、噪声污染。

normal.en: The oldest English sense was religious: pollution meant ritual uncleanness before it meant smoke.
normal.cn: 最早的英语义项是宗教性的：pollution 先指仪式上的不洁，后指烟尘。

normal.en: Poll looks alike but means 'head', so it is a false relative.
normal.cn: poll 形似而同源无关，意为「头」，是假同源。

abstract.en: Picture a clear river receiving one pipe and losing its colour downstream.
abstract.cn: 想象一条清河接入一根管子，下游就失了颜色。

abstract.en: Picture a night sky erased by a ring of lamps.
abstract.cn: 想象一圈路灯抹掉了夜空。

abstract.en: Picture a library shelf filled with books that repeat nonsense.
abstract.cn: 想象书架上塞满反复讲胡话的书。

examples.en: Pollution in the estuary comes from farms far upstream.
examples.cn: 河口处的污染来自远在上游的农田。

examples.en: The city monitors pollution every hour at ten stations.
examples.cn: 该市在十个监测站每小时监测污染。

examples.en: Noise pollution from the highway reaches the school.
examples.cn: 公路的噪声污染传到了学校。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「pollute（污染）+ ion」——把脏东西放进环境这件事，以及它造成的状态 → 污染

root: 拉丁 pollutio「玷污」< polluere「弄脏」；polluere 通常拆为 por-（pro- 变体）+ luere「洗」，但「洗」转为「弄脏」未获完整解释，luere 的更深来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses follow one intrusion: a clean medium is entered, its state changes, each medium gets its own name, energy and waste join the list, and the old religious image survives at one end while the metaphor of a spoiled shared medium survives at the other.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项沿一次侵入展开：洁净介质被进入，状态改变，各介质各得一名，能量与废物加入清单，一端留着旧的宗教意象，另一端留着「共用介质被弄坏」的比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an oily sheen on a river bend, with reeds tangled in plastic cord.
core.cn: 核心意象：河湾上一层油光，芦苇缠着塑料绳。

branches.en: ACT AND STATE: English uses one noun for the putting-in and for what is left afterwards.
branches.cn: 动作与状态：英语用同一个名词兼指「放入」与「放入后剩下的」。

branches.en: THREE MEDIA: air, water and soil each make pollution visible in a different way.
branches.cn: 三种介质：空气、水与土壤各以不同方式让污染显形。

branches.en: ADDED ENERGY AND WASTE: noise, light and plastic all fit the same frame of something extra.
branches.cn: 能量与废物：噪声、光与塑料都落在「多出来的东西」这同一框架里。

branches.en: OLD ROOT: ritual defilement is the image from which the environmental sense grew.
branches.cn: 旧根：仪式上的玷污是环境义从中长出的意象。

branches.en: NEW ROOT: information pollution repeats the image in a shared medium of thought.
branches.cn: 新枝：信息污染在同一意象上重复，只是介质成了共用的思想空间。

intro.en: Pollution is a Latin noun of action with a debated root, so the suffix and prefix are clear while the semantic history of the root is not.
intro.cn: pollution 是拉丁动作名词，词根有争议，因此前缀与后缀清楚，而词根的语义历史不清楚。

latinIntro.en: Latin polluere gives pollute, pollution, pollutant and polluter; -io, -ionis forms nouns of action in English -ion.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 polluere 衍生 pollute、pollution、pollutant 与 polluter；-io, -ionis 在英语中构成 -ion 动作名词。

items.example: One account reads the prefix as directional.
items.exampleCN: 一种说法把这个前缀读作方向性的。

items.example: The washing element is the disputed half of the verb.
items.exampleCN: 「洗」这个成分是动词中有争议的一半。

items.example: Polluere named both ritual and physical uncleanness.
items.exampleCN: polluere 兼指仪式与物理上的不洁。

items.example: The suffix turns the verb into a noun of action.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把动词变成动作名词。

items.meaning: a defiling; the state of being defiled
items.example: Pollution closed the beach.
items.exampleCN: 污染使海滩关闭。

items.example: The plant polluted the creek.
items.exampleCN: 工厂污染了小溪。

items.example: Each pollutant has a limit.
items.exampleCN: 每种污染物都有上限。

items.example: The polluter paid a fine.
items.exampleCN: 污染者缴纳了罚款。

items.example: The polluted stream ran black.
items.exampleCN: 受污染的小溪流着黑水。

items.example: Polluting fuels were taxed.
items.exampleCN: 造成污染的燃料被征税。
